name: SH2 Cast - Right (self)
description: MSCO's Base - Self Right art (its self-delivery right set) on the neutral MSCO_left1-4 path names, for a fire-and-forget SELF cast resolved to the RIGHT hand. SpellHotbar_SpellAnimationType (0x815) == 2 is kSelf.primary; SpellHotbar_CastingSource (0x835) == 1 is the right hand. Each clip carries MSCO's own MRh_SpellFire_Event; per-file stamps keep every clip byte-unique (ADR-0017).
